inlines.v: FA'DING, participle present tense [See Fade.] 1. Losing color; becoming less vivid; decaying; declining; withering. 2. adjective Subject to decay; liable to lose freshness and vigor; liable to perish; not durable; transient; as a fading flower. FA'DING, noun Decay; loss of color, freshness or vigor.
